- **The PR's diff:** Commit 48e24bf7 only touches `infra/environments/dev/core-api.core.tf`, which is comment text, and `implementer-output.json`. It can't affect the `@biffo/cli` tests.
- **The failure:** The failing run was in a different checkout, `/tmp/builder-33un9zbl`. It hit `mkdtempSync` errors in 104 test files at once, which points to `/tmp` trouble at the time (I didn't identify the cause).
- **Isolated re-run:** In this checkout, `doctor-reaper.integration.test.ts` passes 20 of 20.
- **Full re-run:** `pnpm run test` in `/tmp/builder-2lwx2ano/cli` passes as above. `/tmp` now has 5.7G free.

The only uncommitted change is `builder-output.json`, which is now empty (I did not restore it). It looks like a stray artifact and isn't part of the fix. I left it alone.

I did not run the Python `pytest` check that the gate flagged as "NOT RUN". It wasn't among the reported failures, and a comment-only Terraform change can't affect it.

The push should succeed when retried.
